profiles.query: SELECT id,username FROM lx_profiles ORDER BY id

follows.query: SELECT follower_id,followee_id FROM lx_follows ORDER BY follower_id,followee_id

tweets.query: SELECT t.id,t.seed_id,t.content,p.username,t.created_at,t.likes,t.comments FROM lx_tweets t JOIN lx_profiles p ON p.id=t.author_id ORDER BY t.id
